# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 11 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Shadow — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--surface);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | #faf6ef | #131b2b | Page background — warm linen by day, deep navy at night. |
| `surface-raised` | #fffdf9 | #1b2538 | Cards, sheets, the message composer. |
| `surface-sunken` | #f1eadf | #0e1522 | Wells and quiet sections: past notes, settings groups. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--line);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (11)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `line` | #e2d8c8 | #2c3850 | Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative, not a control boundary). |
| `line-strong` | #8f7e66 | #6f7d99 | Input and control borders — at least 3:1 on every surface in both themes. |
| `green` | #2f6b4f | #8cc3a4 | Olive green: the primary action, selected states, progress. As text on any surface or green-soft (5.2:1 or more). |
| `green-soft` | #e2eee5 | #1c3328 | Calm tinted backgrounds: a sent-note confirmation, a gentle tip. Text on it is ink or green. |
| `wood` | #8a5a36 | #d4a77e | Walnut brown — the bridge itself: secondary emphasis, the recipient's name, illustration. As text on any surface or wood-soft (4.8:1 or more). |
| `wood-soft` | #f3e7d7 | #33271b | Warm tinted backgrounds: the 'To' strip on a note, onboarding panels. |
| `navy` | #24365c | #2b3f68 | Deep navy fill: the night band, headers, hero panels. A fill, not a text colour; text on it is on-navy. |
| `lavender` | #6a58a6 | #b9abe8 | Reserved for Jisr's own voice: AI suggestions, rewrite hints. As text on any surface or lavender-soft (4.9:1 or more). |
| `lavender-soft` | #ece8f6 | #2a2442 | Background of an AI suggestion chip or panel. Text on it is ink or lavender. |
| `urgent` | #b0432a | #f2917a | Clay red, safety only: 'reach out now' banners and the crisis button. Always paired with words and an icon, never colour alone. As text on any surface or urgent-soft (4.6:1 or more). |
| `urgent-soft` | #f9e4dc | #3b1f19 | Background of the safety banner. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Readex Pro (Google Fonts): soft, open Arabic and Latin forms. Headlines only. IBM Plex Sans Arabic (Google Fonts). Arabic needs room: body never below 15px, line height 1.6 or more.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-display);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 34px / 48px | 600 | `display` | One per screen: onboarding and empty states. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 24px / 36px | 500 | `display` | Screen titles. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 19px / 30px | 500 | `display` | Section and card headings. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 17px / 28px | 400 | `sans` | Message drafts and all reading text. |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 15px / 24px | 400 | `sans` | Helper text, card metadata. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 15px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Buttons, chips, tabs. |
| `caption` | `.caption`, `--text-caption` | 13px / 20px | 500 | `sans` | Timestamps and privacy notes. Never for anything the person must read to stay safe. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Readex Pro", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "Readex Pro", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

4px base, generous: calm screens breathe.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap. |
| `space-2` | 8px | Inside chips; between stacked labels. |
| `space-3` | 12px | Between related rows. |
| `space-4` | 16px | Screen side margin on mobile; button padding. |
| `space-6` | 24px | Card padding; between cards. |
| `space-8` | 32px | Between sections. |

## Radius

Soft and arched: large radii everywhere, pills for chips — echoing the bridge's arches.

### Use

```css
/* var(--radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-sm` | 8px | Inputs, small chips' inner elements. |
| `radius-md` | 14px | Buttons, banners. |
| `radius-lg` | 24px | Cards, sheets, the composer. |
| `radius-full` | 9999px | Pills, avatars, the AI suggestion chip. |

## Shadow

Barely-there, warm-tinted elevation; flatter at night.

### Use

```css
/* var(--shadow-sm) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-sm` | 0 1px 2px #1d2a440d, 0 2px 6px #1d2a4412 · dark: 0 1px 3px #00000066 | Cards at rest. |
| `shadow-lg` | 0 8px 24px -6px #1d2a4426 · dark: 0 12px 28px -4px #000000a6 | Bottom sheets and dialogs. |
| `focus-ring` | 0 0 0 2px #faf6ef, 0 0 0 4px #2f6b4f · dark: 0 0 0 2px #131b2b, 0 0 0 4px #8cc3a4 | Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the page colour, then 2px of solid green (5.2:1 or more on every surface). |
